P(recall) = (1-slip)*(1 + gap/s)^(-beta), s = exp(a + b*cleans - c*struggles - d*assist). node_status() calls a node SOLID while the memory component (1 + gap/s)^(-beta) >= target_retention; delete this file to fall back to the flat 42-day window.
